step1_analysis.description: The circuit consists of two NMOS transistors connected in series with their gates tied together. This structure is typically used as a pull-down network in digital logic gates or as a stacked switch to reduce leakage or handle higher voltages.

paper_reference.title: Simulation and Measurement of Supply and Substrate Noise in Mixed-Signal ICs

dc_power.description: Total DC power consumption of the circuit.

sky130_expected.calculation: With a 10k pull-up resistor and effective W/L of 5 (two 5u/0.5u in series), the transistors operate in the linear region at Vin=0.9V. Req ≈ 1 / (uCox * (W/L)eff * (Vgs - Vth)) ≈ 1 / (270u * 5 * 0.48) ≈ 1.5 kOhm. Total resistance ≈ 11.5 kOhm. Current ≈ 1.8V / 11.5k ≈ 156 uA. Power = 1.8V * 156uA ≈ 280 uW.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Based on standard square-law triode equations for SKY130 NMOS parameters.

voltage_gain.description: AC voltage gain from the input to the output node at 1 MHz.

sky130_expected.calculation: Since the transistors are in deep triode, the transconductance is low and the output resistance is dominated by the 10k load and the triode channel resistance. Gain will be negative in dB.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Triode operation significantly reduces the intrinsic gain compared to saturation.

output_swing.description: Peak-to-peak voltage swing at the output during transient operation.

sky130_expected.calculation: Input is a 1MHz sine wave with 0.1V amplitude. The small-signal gain is roughly -10dB (0.3 V/V). Output swing ≈ 0.2Vpp * 0.3 ≈ 0.06 Vpp.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Derived from the expected AC gain and the 0.2V peak-to-peak input swing.

step3_testbench.description: Testbench to measure DC power, AC voltage gain at 1MHz, and transient output swing of the stacked NMOS circuit.
step3_testbench.spice:
* Stacked NMOS Testbench
.lib "${SKY130_PDK}/models/sky130.lib.spice" tt

.param W_xm1=5u L_xm1=0.5u
.param W_xm2=5u L_xm2=0.5u

* DUT
XM1 N9 INPUT N3 N4 sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm1} w={W_xm1}
XM2 N2 INPUT N9 N0 sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm2} w={W_xm2}

* Biasing and Loads
RL N2 VDD 10k
VN3 N3 0 0
VN4 N4 0 0
VN0 N0 0 0

* Sources
VVDD VDD 0 1.8
VINPUT INPUT 0 DC 0.9 AC 1 SIN(0.9 0.1 1MEG 0 0)

.control
* 1. DC Operating Point
op
let dc_power = -i(VVDD) * 1.8
print dc_power

* 2. AC Analysis
ac dec 100 1k 100MEG
let gain_db = vdb(N2)
meas ac gain_1mhz find gain_db at=1MEG

* 3. Transient Analysis
tran 10n 5u
meas tran vout_max max v(N2)
meas tran vout_min min v(N2)
let output_swing = vout_max - vout_min
print output_swing

quit
.endc
.end
